goal: Determine which OEW blockers are real runtime or source defects and which are created by the current governance and exact-byte workflow, then specify the smallest rebuild that yields a browser-testable Poker-Team prototype without adding package manifests.
context: Implementation is paused before SWU-OEW-007T mutation admission. The pinned Understand-Anything source already owns a pnpm workspace with core and dashboard packages; attempt 003 passed frozen install, explicit core build, and dashboard Vitest, then failed on 48 strict TypeScript errors in three OEW overlay files. Research must independently test whether package SHA pinning is merely reproducibility metadata or an actual product blocker, quantify the cost of each refresh loop, and return a concrete keep/rebuild/delete plan rather than another implementation work pack.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs an empirical clean-runtime reproduction while agent 1 reconstructs the receipt and refresh chronology on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a runtime-only bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 1's causal timeline, while a governance-only bias in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 0's commands.

Agent 0 measures the pinned workspace as it exists while agent 2 minimizes the architecture around the user-visible prototype on the methodology axis; an acceptance-harness bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 2's smaller product witness, while an oversimplification bias in agent 2 would be exposed by agent 0's build evidence.

Agent 1 audits historical ownership and refresh costs while agent 2 designs a forward minimum architecture on the temporal-prior and source-corpus axes; path-dependence in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 2's clean-slate model, while omitted migration constraints in agent 2 would be exposed by agent 1's receipt ledger.

agents.angle: empirical clean-runtime reproduction over the pinned Understand-Anything pnpm workspace
agents.initial_prompt: Read only the pinned source archive, L1-BUILD.lock.json, root/core/dashboard package manifests and tsconfigs, the three OEW overlay sources, attempt-003 build evidence, and existing focused tests. In an isolated temporary workroot, reproduce the minimum install/core/test/dashboard-build sequence without changing repository files and without creating a package manifest. Classify every failure as environment, dependency topology, ordinary source defect, or hash/lock failure. Report exact commands, package topology, whether any package.json was actually added by recent work, and a complete path-by-path corpus ledger. The Inventory packet contributes only the prior-audit lead that upstream pnpm/Vite/TypeScript mechanics already exist; verify it independently.

agents.angle: historical causal reconstruction of blocker, refresh, ownership, and session-budget transitions
agents.initial_prompt: Read all OEW L1 selection, refresh, Task Session, closeout, chain-state, manifest, and continuity receipts from the first working-version selection through the interrupted 007T preflight. Build a chronological table with one row per stop: immediate technical cause, underlying cause, whether the stop protected a real invariant, whether it was induced by plan/write-set granularity, files changed to unblock it, sessions consumed, and whether user-visible prototype capability advanced. Quantify governance churn separately from runtime work and preserve a complete per-path corpus ledger. Use the prior coverage-rejected audit only as a lead and recheck current bytes.

agents.angle: minimum browser-prototype architecture derived from user-visible obligations rather than current work-pack history
agents.initial_prompt: Start from the user-visible target: a browser-testable OEW using the Poker-Team fixture and Understand-Anything UI substrate. Read current architecture, the pinned upstream workspace, OEW package/scripts, overlay/test files, global Playwright contract, and current browser SWUs. Design the smallest architecture that can run locally with no new package.json, no copied dependency graph, and no ontology/promotion claim. Compare at least: continue current 007T→013B chain, thin adapter inside the upstream pnpm workspace, and a static/Node-native prototype lane. Return a component diagram, exact keep/rebuild/delete/defer matrix, migration boundary, and one executable acceptance sequence. The Inventory packet requires per-artifact dispositions because the prior audit lacked them.

Reconcile the three explorer returns into an exact-binding synthesis. Produce a causal diagnosis that separates package topology, exact SHA guards, real TypeScript/source defects, and governance-induced blockers. Evaluate four candidates: continue the current chain, thin adapter on the upstream workspace, static/Node-native prototype, and a new generalized runtime. Every load-bearing row must cite an explorer return plus exact source identity and selector or command. Include measured churn, a keep/rebuild/delete/defer matrix, the smallest browser witness, and explicit unresolved evidence. Do not write findings.md; return the synthesis package to the strategist for evidence closure and skeptic review.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 attacks by precedent and ownership while agent 1 attacks by non-vacuity on the attack-vector axis; a rebuild bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 1's concrete runnable no-new-package demand, while a demo-only bias in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 0's upstream pnpm/Vite/Playwright ownership analysis.

agents.angle: precedent and ownership attack against rebuilding mechanics already owned by upstream or the OEW adapter
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesis only on the precedent gate. Verify which package, workspace, build, test, browser, fixture, and receipt mechanics already have an owner in pinned Understand-Anything, the OEW adapter, global Playwright, or prior accepted local patterns. Being owned is positive: label build-from-owned or already-deployed, never KILL. Reject any recommendation that invents a generalized runtime without a missing behavior. Return exact citations and gaps.

agents.angle: non-vacuity attack requiring a runnable no-new-package browser witness and measurable simplification
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesis only on non-vacuity. Require one concrete, bounded witness that starts from the pinned source and Poker-Team data, changes no package manifest, reaches a browser page, and has an explicit failure boundary. Require a before/after count of runtime roots, package manifests owned by OEW, planning gates, and commands. KILL a candidate that cannot provide a runnable witness or measurable simplification; preserve the exact fact that kills it.

After the strategist declares exact-binding evidence closure ready, write findings.md only. Lead with a plain-language answer to whether this is a package/SHA problem, a TypeScript source problem, a governance problem, or a mix. Include the verdict matrix, blocker chronology, measured churn, package-topology explanation, minimum architecture, exact keep/rebuild/delete/defer table, browser acceptance sequence, and a stop-doing list. Mark every deferred, killed, or unresolved row honestly. Do not authorize implementation or mutate OEW source.

Audit findings.md only against the dispatch goal and exact-binding contract. Verify the answer distinguishes upstream package topology from newly added package manifests, distinguishes SHA validation from runtime causality, preserves the real strict-TypeScript evidence, quantifies governance churn, provides per-artifact dispositions, and names one no-new-package browser witness. Approve or return one bounded writer revision; reject any implementation authorization, ontology correctness, release, or production claim.
